verdict.rationale: Runloop's docs say it ships official SDKs in common languages, and name Python and TypeScript SDKs. It also provides Cursor rule files covering SDK use for devbox lifecycle, file operations, command execution, blueprints, snapshots and tunnels, which supports the AI-native angle. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference content in the evidence (versioning, language breadth beyond Python/TypeScript), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
